note: USACE Nashville District campground on Lake Barkley where the canal joins it to Kentucky Lake, at the north end of Land Between the Lakes near Grand Rivers; views of Barkley Dam and the canal traffic. Wooded loops; the cheaper Primitive loop's sites are mostly under 23 ft. Swimming beach, boat ramp and courtesy dock, fishing float, playground, picnic pavilions, short hiking trail. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees $30 -> $20-40 (Primitive loop $20, 50A W/E $30-32, full hookup $40). 50A, 17 sewer sites, 115 sites, max 99 ft, season 03-26..10-25 from the rec.gov calendar. Lakefront confirmed on Boat Ramp Point (093-095) and the Hill loop (075-077), all sold by the night. Phone/website current; pin in the woods ~145 m from the Hill loop (under the 250 m line).
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED (stored lakefront): on Esri imagery the Boat Ramp Point loop's sites 093 (37.000507,-88.211403), 094 (37.000612,-88.211567) and 095 (37.000703,-88.211530) sit on an open grassy point ~23-30 m from Lake Barkley's summer-pool edge, with only a thin fringe of shoreline trees; Hill loop sites 075 (36.997519,-88.210337), 076 (36.997596,-88.210669) and 077 (36.997609,-88.210798) are ~23 m from the water but under canopy (bank height can't be read; the loop name suggests a rise). The Flats (103-110) sit behind the boat-ramp parking lot, ~60-90 m from water. All of these are reservable by the night. rec.gov: 'The campground faces Barkley Lake, and the shore of Kentucky Lake is a brisk one-mile walk across the canal' - the old note's 'waterfront on one of the two lakes' was wrong about Kentucky Lake and is dropped.
FEES: stored 30/30 -> 20/40. The $20 sites are 30A in the Primitive loop and many are short (18-24 ft), but 001 (32 ft), 003 (30), 008 (35) and 009 (30) take a 23-ft rig.
SITE 020 (50A, sewer, 36.996544,-88.216644) is the only non-reservable site - likely the host's; not counted in the hookup source.
RULES: militaryDiscount rule present (not a discount claim; nothing written). No minimum-stay rule.

PIN: stored 36.9955556,-88.2097222 (rec.gov's facility point) is in the woods on the peninsula SE of the Hill loop, ~145 m from site 068 and ~400 m from the middle of the campground; under the 250 m line, so no move. A better point would be the Beach loop, ~36.9969,-88.2128, if wanted.
PHONE/WEBSITE: 270-362-4840 (rec.gov) and https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232541 current. No change. Nashville District's own lake page not read.
